summary: Status and human approval for an operation invoked by an AI assistant.
whenToUse: Showing operations that are running, completed, failed or awaiting approval.

props.name: onApprove / onReject
props.description: Actions shown in the approval state, when provided.

keyboard.action: Standard controls expand details and trigger actions.

accessibility: Status updates are announced via a live region.
The failed state uses role=alert; approvals are explicit actions.
responsive: Header and actions wrap in narrow containers.
customization: Variants use status tokens and can be overridden with external CSS.
commonMistakes: The component only displays status: wire up the actions and update status in the consumer.
limits: Actions and operation status are managed by the consumer.
